name: show-a-commit

steps.command: echo two > a.txt; echo b > b.txt

steps.stdout:
commit <c1*>

    first

diff --git a/a.txt b/a.txt
--- a/a.txt
+++ b/a.txt
@@ -0,0 +1 @@
+one

commit <c2*>

    second

diff --git a/a.txt b/a.txt
--- a/a.txt
+++ b/a.txt
@@ -1 +1 @@
-one
+two
diff --git a/b.txt b/b.txt
--- a/b.txt
+++ b/b.txt
@@ -0,0 +1 @@
+b

steps.stderr:
